if(DBG)
    add_definitions(-D_DEBUG=1)
endif()

add_rc_deps(rsrc.rc ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/res/notepad.ico)

# notepad.exe is all Rust (notepad-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/notepad-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# dialog.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/notepad-rust/src/notepad/dialog.rs)
# main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/notepad-rust/src/notepad/main.rs)
# printing.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/notepad-rust/src/notepad/printing.rs)
# settings.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/notepad-rust/src/notepad/settings.rs)
# text.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/notepad-rust/src/notepad/text.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(notepad_res OBJECT rsrc.rc)
target_compile_definitions(notepad_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(notepad_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(NOTEPAD_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/CMakeFiles/oldnames.dir/oldnames.a)
add_cargo_module(notepad notepad-cargo notepad.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE notepad-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS notepad_res ${NOTEPAD_REUSED})
